static_traits.name: An Jie
static_traits.educational_background: Master's degree in library and information science
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends and family to ask for help, but often finds it hard to reveal shyness and confidence problems to them
static_traits.medical_history: Lifelong shyness, no significant physical illness; has not received formal psychotherapy or counseling in the past
static_traits.language_features: Nervous tone, restrained yet clear expression; able to describe automatic thoughts and worries; cooperativeness in counseling is better, willing to try small-step actions

basic_info.main_problem: Because of shyness, I have difficulty meeting new friends and establishing new relationships. I often stammer when talking with people and feel I lack the confidence needed for socializing. The stress of divorce and the need to 'start over' have aggravated my shyness and confidence problems.
basic_info.core_demands: Because after the divorce I became aware that shyness hinders my ability to build new relationships, I hope to improve shyness and confidence problems through counseling, so as to better connect with others.
growth_experiences: Lifelong shyness: the client has felt shy and tense in Social situations for as long as she can remember, tending to stutter and avoid eye contact when interacting with strangers, worrying about others' judgment. Even so, her Work performance (children's library work) is not yet significantly affected; the main troubles center on social life and relationship building outside work.

Major life event — recently divorced: the divorce brought considerable stress and the real demands of 'starting over', making her shyness and lack of confidence more prominent. In Social situations, especially when needing to meet new friends or build new connections, avoidance and tension increased markedly, deepening daily loneliness.

core_beliefs: I will never have the confidence I need
I will embarrass myself socially and be judged by others

special_situations.event: Trying to talk with new colleagues at a work party
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I stutter or pause while speaking, others will find me awkward or boring, not worth continuing to talk to
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Standing aside, avoiding eye contact, speaking up less proactively to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am strange, then walk away

special_situations.event: Attending social activities or parties, needing to meet strangers proactively
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot appear confident and fluent, I will embarrass myself and be negatively judged
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding attending or minimizing talking to people, to be 'safer'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will humiliate myself; things will go terribly

special_situations.event: Greeting a stranger for the first time or starting a chat
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot speak well this time, it proves I have never been capable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces attempts, stays silent to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I fail every time; I am always like this

special_situations.event: Needing to start over and build new relationships after the divorce
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am still so shy now, it means I am not worth accepting, and only others' approval gives me value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Highly concerned about others' evaluations, seeks external recognition to confirm self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Unless I become better, others will not want to associate with me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and to build intimate and reliable new relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged, humiliated or rejected, thereby exposing one's 'insufficiency'
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated by staying distant and avoidant, maintaining security

object_relations.self_representation: A judged, clumsy outsider (a person prone to embarrassment)
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges (people ready to reject or belittle oneself at any time)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When he needs to proactively talk with strangers in social settings, or when the counselor encourages conducting a 'behavioral experiment'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will watch my shortcomings like judges, ready to reject me at any time (viewing others as potential rejecters)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a calm but avoidant tone emphasizes 'this is safer', raises many concerns and preconditions, trying to shrink the scope of attempts and postpone action.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When at gatherings or work events, feeling possibly watched, saying the wrong thing, or being misunderstood
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I speak up, others will discover I am terrible and awkward (magnifying potential evaluation into certain negation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language, belittling one's abilities, soft and hesitant tone, reducing interaction frequency and proactively exiting conversations.

manifestations: Shyness and Social avoidance lead to limited social interaction outside work
Standing aside at social events, avoiding eye contact, not initiating conversation
Blocked in building new relationships after divorce
The need to 'start over' after divorce brings stress and uncertainty
Feeling Anxiety about bearing the responsibility of freedom and choice
outcomes: Reinforced worries about failure and being judged

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Standing aside at gatherings, avoiding eye contact
Not initiating conversations to avoid facing tension and judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Self-stating 'I should meet new friends in social settings', demanding of oneself by external norms
Treating 'must be confident and fluent' as a rigid rule

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Believing 'no matter what I do it is useless, I just cannot shake off shyness'
Excessively worrying about details and self-denial before starting conversations

positive_force: Willing to try change and accept small-step actions (willing to do behavioral experiments)
Work performance is stable; has professional ability and a structured daily routine
Has some social support (a few friends and family to seek help from)
Once actively pushed oneself out of the comfort zone to talk with people
negative_force: Cognitive distortions like catastrophizing, overgeneralization and predicting the future reinforce Fear of socializing
High Social avoidance and dependence on external evaluation
Lifelong shyness and lack of confidence lead to Self-denial
Post-divorce stress and uncertainty worsen Anxiety and withdrawal

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and difficulty initiating conversations (with tension and stuttering)
antecedent: Attending social activities or parties, needing to meet new friends
Work-related group activities (such as colleague gatherings)
Greeting a stranger for the first time or starting a chat
target_behavior.core_reason: Cognition of fearing judgment and embarrassment (catastrophizing and predicting the future); long learning history of shyness; post-divorce stress and the uncertainty of 'starting over' intensify tension
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome things (others' negative evaluation, embarrassment) to gain subjective security
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building new relationships, increased loneliness, further reinforcing Self-denial and avoidance patterns
